settings.text: Four people, one bench.Twelve pieces a year.
We do not run a season and we do not restock a chapter once it closes. What we make is what four people can finish properly in a year, which is about twelve pieces.
Belo Horizonte, on the second floor.
Túlio opened the bench in 2015 with one polishing motor and a borrowed rolling mill. Both are still in the room. Nothing is cast off site, and every piece is finished by the person who set it.

settings.image_alt: The bench in Belo Horizonte, tools laid out on the block

settings.heading: The gold is refined in São Paulo
settings.text: Recycled, refined and certified. We can show the refiner's certificate for any piece, and we would rather you asked.

settings.heading: Stones are chosen one at a time
settings.text: Two cutters, both used for eleven years. Every stone is seen in daylight before it is bought. Nothing is ordered from a photograph.

settings.heading: Twenty-one days at the bench
settings.text: Filed, set and polished by hand. The tool marks inside a band are Túlio's, and they stay.

settings.heading: Numbered, then wrapped
settings.text: The piece number is struck last, recorded against your order, and kept for any repair — for as long as the piece exists.

settings.image_alt: A ring held in the setting block at the bench
settings.heading: How a piece is made
Resizing, for life
settings.text: Free, up to three sizes either way, for as long as you own the piece. We send a prepaid insured label.

settings.heading: Polishing, forever
settings.text: Send a piece in whenever it stops looking like itself. There is no charge and no time limit.

settings.heading: Repairs, quoted first
settings.text: Nothing is touched before you have the number. We will say honestly when a repair is not worth doing.

settings.quote: I have worn it every day for two years. It has been polished twice and resized once, both free.
settings.name: Marina A.

settings.quote: Twenty-one days, and they wrote twice while it was being made. I knew exactly where it was.
settings.name: Júlia R.

settings.quote: It is 9.4 grams and I can feel every one of them. That is the whole point.
settings.name: Pedro V.
